name: Monbetsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Monbetsu city emblem in green: a ring enclosing a stylised hourglass-shaped character.
history: Municipal flag of Monbetsu, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 July 1978; the emblem dates from 1 July 1941.

features.role: Monbetsu city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised hourglass-shaped character
